team.name: Vikram Mohindru
team.biography_html:
Vikram Mohindru is an insurance agent in Florida with a unique background in information technology services. He leads a team of experienced and knowledgeable agents who excel in providing quality services across various insurance products, including auto, home, life, and flood insurance.

Leveraging his IT experience, Vikram introduces innovative technologies to enhance customer experiences, making insurance processes smoother and more efficient. His team's deep understanding of Florida's specific insurance needs ensures that customers receive tailored service suitable for the state's unique environment.

Proactive in customer relationship management, Vikram and his team offer personalized services, helping ensure customers' coverage meets their evolving needs. Beyond professional services, they are actively engaged in supporting local community initiatives, embodying a commitment to customer security and community well-being.

team.name: Matt Pendleton
team.biography_html: Matt grew up in Bloomington, Indiana, and possesses a strong mid-west work ethic. He has lived in SW Florida since 2001. As the son of a longtime insurance agent, he has been involved in or around the insurance industry his entire life. Matt is married with two kids and loves spending time with his family and enjoying the water. He has many years of expertise and knowledge, and he takes pride in ensuring that each of his clients is well taken care of and protected.

team.name: Dhimir Patel
team.biography_html: Dhimir has been working with the Aaspire Agency for 9 years as their insurance processor. He collaborates with the sales agents to help bind the policies for the insured and sends out the required documents for them to sign.

team.name: Johnny Barrett
team.biography_html: Johnny grew up in South Carolina before moving to the Fort Myers/Cape Coral area in 1997 with his family. His parents, Brenda and his father, have been together for 24 years. Johnny has an older sister named Elizabeth, who is 16. He enjoys living in Florida and taking advantage of all the great activities the state has to offer, including visits to the beaches, boating, fishing, camping, exploring springs, and soaking up the sunshine!

team.name: Dmitriy Odnoralov
team.biography_html: Dmitriy has a professional background in sales and customer service. He is proud to be an insurance agent and is confident in his ability to help people better understand insurance and provide them with the coverage they need. Dmitriy is dedicated to customer satisfaction and enjoys building relationships within the insurance industry. He is constantly striving to advance his career through product knowledge, experience, and training to offer the best service for his clients.

team.name: Victoria Ortiz
team.biography_html: Victoria is a SWFL native with a passion for exploration and discovery. Whether she's road-tripping across FL and neighboring states or tracking down the best local eats and boba spots, she’s always chasing the next hidden gem. Her love for nature shines through in her photography and frequent visits to parks and trails. When she’s not behind the lens, she enjoys learning American Sign Language (ASL) and deepening her connection to the world around her.
